title: A readable diff for a crew roster
heading: Compare Field by Field, Within Tolerances Stated in Business Units
cases: an identical record gives no lines, and one with a new cost and a job on another crew gives exactly those two lines
a cost that differs by solver noise is the same cost, and one that differs by more than $1 is not
a job the new roster assigns and the golden one did not is reported as well as one it dropped
overtime of 0 against 0.004 hours is the same, since the tolerance is in hours, not a share of the value
when the status changed, that is the only line, since the rest cannot be compared
